customManagers.description: prek hook revs (prek.toml) — inline renovate comments (datasource=github-tags). No manager understands prek TOML, so without this the hook pins only move when someone runs `prek autoupdate`.

The oxlint version the prek hook installs (prek.toml additional_dependencies). It must equal package.json's (scripts/__tests__/version-pins.test.ts), so it moves in the same pull request: see the oxlint rule below.

packageRules.description: Bump the package.json range with the lockfile, as Dependabot did: a range left at its old floor would make the prek oxlint pin differ from package.json.
oxlint is pinned twice (package.json and the prek hook): one pull request moves both.

TypeScript 7 dropped the `typescript/lib/tsc` subpath from its package exports map, which vue-tsc still requires internally: bumping past 6.x breaks `bun run typecheck`. Re-allow once vue-tsc ships TS7 support.

github-workflows pins (ci-cd.yml, and the prek.toml hook rev) come with each of its releases, as a pull request its propagate-release job opens: Renovate would only duplicate them, and would pin them to SHAs.
